A large organization develops software using teams located in Chennai, Bangalore, and Delhi. Before implementation begins, interface specifications are finalized. Which statements about interfaces are correct?
options: They specify permitted requests and outputs.
They reveal the complete implementation details.
They allow independent development of components.
Implementation can change without affecting dependent modules if the interface remains unchanged.
correct_answer: They specify permitted requests and outputs.
They allow independent development of components.
Implementation can change without affecting dependent modules if the interface remains unchanged.
